status_summary: An Attorney General memorandum of 2025-02-05 directed prosecutors to charge the most serious readily provable offense, defined as those carrying the most significant mandatory minimums, and named the ACCA as an example. S. 2250 and its House companion H.R. 4334, each titled the Restoring the Armed Career Criminal Act, were introduced on 2025-07-10 and referred to the Judiciary Committees. The Senate bill would replace 18 U.S.C. 924(e) with a 15-to-30-year mandatory sentence based on three prior serious felony convictions. No committee action was found.

timeline.event: The Attorney General's charging memorandum directed prosecutors to pursue the most serious readily provable offense and cited ACCA as an example of a statute with a significant mandatory minimum.
